stem.text: Two glass vessels, M and N, are connected by a closed valve.

stem.alt: Two glass vessels labelled M (small sphere, left) and N (large sphere, right) joined by a horizontal tube containing a closed valve.

stem.text: M contains helium at $20\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ at a pressure of $1 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$. N has been evacuated, and has three times the volume of M.
The valve is opened and the temperature of the whole apparatus is raised to $100\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
What is the final pressure in the system?
